name: delete-merged-branch

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [closed]

jobs:
  delete-branch:
    if: github.event.pull_request.merged == true && github.event.pull_request.head.ref != github.event.repository.default_branch
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Delete merged branch
        uses: dawidd6/action-delete-branch@v3
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branches: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
